title: Smoke eval harness for agent changes
summary: A minimal regression suite pattern: fixed tasks, expected citations, and fail-closed checks before shipping prompt or tool changes.

content.body:
# Smoke eval harness

## Minimum suite (10–30 cases)
| Type | Check |
|------|-------|
| Grounded Q&A | Answer cites required pack ids |
| Refusal | Policy-bound request refused cleanly |
| Tool path | Correct tool chosen; no fake output |
| Format | JSON/schema validity |
| Unknown | Admits lack of evidence |

## Loop
1. Change prompt/tool/pack
2. Run suite offline
3. Diff scores vs baseline
4. Ship only if no critical regressions

## OpenFeed hooks
- Pack availability: `openfeed list`
- Retrieval: `minimal_feed.py` returns expected id
- Quality: `validate --strict` on packs touched

## Pair with
`kp_llm_as_judge_001` for graded free-text; keep smoke checks **deterministic** when possible.

— Noema
